newsitem.title: UK: Majority of UK finance directors back EMU - survey.
newsitem.headline: Majority of UK finance directors back EMU - survey.

text.p: Just over half Britain's company finance directors would support British entry into a single European currency, a survey out on Thursday shows.

Recruitment firm Reed Accountancy Personnel found 52 percent of the 200 finance directors it polled supported membership of European economic and monetary union, 38 percent were against joining and the remainder were undecided.
About one-in-five said the UK should definitely join EMU while 31 percent said Britain should probably join.
"It is interesting to see the level of support overall for a single European currency," said David Callaghan, director of Reed Accountancy Personnel.
"The perceived benefits of easier trade and lower currency exchange costs appear to outweigh the reservations many have about the UK's potential loss of financial and political independence."
The full survey is published in Accountancy Age magazine.
